_comment: Tag merges. 'clean' applies these to a local copy; 'rename' sends them to Pinboard and needs --yes. The 'case' group is local-only in practice: Pinboard's tag index already folds case (tags/get reports security=22, i.e. 21 'security' + 1 'Security'), so tags/rename has nothing to do there - but posts/all returns the stored per-pin case, so local analysis double-counts without it. Folds are title-checked against the pins before they land here: 'corse' is Corsica not a typo of course, 'nodes' is graph nodes not notes, 'gympl' is a specific school hunt not the school topic.
